subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Is the current source and related PR evidence sufficient to split or close this broad v2026.6.11 all-channel incident, or should it remain open until the shared self-heal and replay fixes land with stable-package proof?
rationale: The issue overlaps multiple real source paths and related trackers, but no single landed fix or live proof currently covers the full WebChat plus WhatsApp one-exchange-then-silence and duplicate-reply report.

options.title: Keep Broad Incident Open
options.body: Keep this issue open until the shared self-heal and replay work lands and maintainers have current-main plus stable-package proof for the combined symptom set.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Move the reply-session, WebChat terminalization, WhatsApp replay, and stuck-recovery pieces under existing narrower issues and close this only after the split is explicit.

options.title: Close After Candidate PRs Land
options.body: Defer the close decision until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365 are either merged with proof or rejected.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Incident Open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the shared self-heal and replay work lands and maintainers have current-main plus stable-package proof for the combined symptom set.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses stable release state, beta/current-main proof, and incident-level tracking rather than one narrow code path.
